subject: Fix up test_skip_index_load.py (#1172)
reason: The change modifies only a Python integration test (test_skip_index_load.py, refactored to use the test framework's create_server instead of raw subprocess) and a CI build script (scripts/common.rc, adding an ELF linker flag so ASAN sanitizer builds load libstdc++ early). No module source, command behaviour, RDB load path, replication logic, or configuration of valkey-search changes, so there is no server-side behaviour for a fuzzer scenario to reach: this is a test/CI-only change that needs no scenario.
